cloudflare_email.description: Cloudflare account email address (used with API key for authentication).

cloudflare_api_key.description: Cloudflare API key (Global API Key or Origin CA Key). Do not expose in logs or configs shared publicly.

domains.description: List of domains and DNS records to manage with dynamic DNS.

records.description: List of DNS record configurations for this domain.

name.description: Record name (e.g., '@' for root, 'www' for www.example.com).

proxied.description: Whether to proxy traffic through Cloudflare (orange cloud).

update_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between dynamic DNS update checks. Minimum recommended: 60.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.
